prompt: I'm procrastinating on a task. Help me to archive it
response: Procrastination can be tough, but breaking the task into smaller parts can help. Try setting a timer for 25 minutes and work on one small part of the task during that time. Then, take a short break before starting the next part. This technique, known as the Pomodoro Technique, can make tasks feel more manageable and help you make steady progress.
